title: Perdikis2018: CNBI EPFL Cybathlon BCI-race motor-imagery dataset
description: EEG recordings from two tetraplegic pilots of team Brain Tweakers (CNBI, EPFL) collected during longitudinal motor-imagery BCI training for the Cybathlon 2016 BCI race. The dataset contains cue-based offline calibration runs of kinesthetic motor imagery (both hands, both feet, rest) recorded with 16 EEG channels at 512 Hz. The data were used to drive an avatar in the BrainRunners game and are re-released in BIDS format via MOABB.
methods_description: 16-channel EEG was recorded at 512 Hz with a g.USBamp amplifier (Ag/AgCl electrodes) over sensorimotor areas. Cue-based trials of both-hands, both-feet and rest motor imagery (about 15 trials per class per run, 4 s imagery) were pooled across several recording days per pilot and treated as a single session. Visual feedback was provided.
